caption: The drawing shows a single, symmetrical object resembling a stylized crown or ceremonial headpiece, centered on a plain, light beige background. The object is composed primarily of a dull gold or brass color, accentuated by vertical rectangular white panels on each side that are adorned with evenly spaced small circles. The crown has a tall, narrow structure with a central vertical section topped by three rounded lobes, the middle being the tallest, ending with a vertical finial and a cluster of three small dots at its tip. Additional decorative elements branch off symmetrically on both sides, resembling leaf-like or wave-like shapes. At the bottom, the base is curved and is also outlined, with a few round rivet-like markings. The drawing has a simple style, using flat colors with minimal shading, and beneath the image, the text “Metal Crown” is handwritten in small letters.
title: Patch Box of Kentucky Rifle
